opening.comment: The agent's first turn gives neither the agent's own name nor the company name, so the opening criterion is not met.

verification.quote: Customer: Hi, is this Tidewell? My toaster doesn't work. It arrived yesterday. My name is Niamh Willems, postcode 2513 AA.
verification.comment: The agent confirmed the caller's name and postcode against the account before discussing the order, which meets the verification requirement.

understanding.quote: Agent: Yes. Thank you, Niamh, that matches your account. I'm sorry it doesn't work out of the box, that's disappointing. So the toaster arrived yesterday and doesn't turn on at all?
understanding.comment: The agent captured the issue accurately and did not ask for details the caller had already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Agent: I'll refund the full €22.00 to your card, you'll see it within 5 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: Items under EUR 25 do not need to be returned, so 'No' was correct, but the refund for a faulty item is a valid option; however, the policy requires a photo before a refund, so the commitment was made too early and the agent should have offered the choice of a replacement.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: I'll refund the full €22.00 to your card, you'll see it within 5 working days.
process_compliance.comment: The agent promised a refund without asking for a photo of the faulty toaster first, which the policy requires for damaged or faulty items.

communication.comment: The agent was reasonably polite and acknowledged the disappointment, but the final replies were curt and the caller's 'Okay' responses were not warmly handled.

closing.comment: The call ended without confirming next steps in full or asking whether the caller needed anything else, so the closing criterion is not met.
